meta.title: Ask the Grid tool manifest
rules: Every tool is read-only and answers only from the files in data/public/.

The model routes the question to tools and words the result. Every figure in an answer is copied from a tool result and shown with its source; the model never calculates, estimates or rounds a figure.
A tool result with an 'error' field means no data: say so, do not guess.
Null means missing data, not zero.
Say 'retrospective' for replay and backtest figures, 'net of electricity' for Copilot money, and 'zone IDs are not confirmed as Scotland' for DFS zones.

Refuse: revenue or profit claims for a real operator, avoided CO2, which region a DFS zone is, why a particular farm was curtailed, any date beyond the forecast target, anything outside Scottish wind.
meta.tool_result_shape: Each result also carries 'source': [{file, fields}] naming the data/public file and fields it was read from.

tools.name: curtailment_for_day
tools.description: Scottish wind curtailed on one day, what wind farms were paid to turn down, and NESO's thermal constraint measures.

date.description: GB date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the curtailment_daily window

tools.name: top_curtailment_days
tools.description: The days with the most curtailed Scottish wind, largest first. Days with null curtailment are skipped.

tools.name: top_farms_for_day
tools.description: The wind farms with the most curtailed energy on a replay day (summed over the day's half-hours). Replay days are listed in replay/index.json.

tools.name: scotex_gap
tools.description: How far the SCOTEX boundary flow exceeded its limit on a replay day: number of half-hours over the limit and the largest overshoot.

tools.name: dfs_requests_for_day
tools.description: NESO demand-flexibility Upwards/System requests starting on a UTC day (or all days if date is omitted): how many, MW asked for, MW procured. Zone IDs are not confirmed as Scotland.

date.description: UTC date of start_utc; omit for the whole file

tools.name: forecast_tomorrow
tools.description: The next-day outlook: templated headline, total and peak curtailment forecast, and the chance NESO asks for flexible demand. Retrospective backtest, not a guarantee.

tools.name: copilot_call
tools.description: The Flex Copilot's call on a replay day: ready windows, bid and result net of electricity. Warm-up days return status not_scored with a reason.

tools.name: farm_lookup
tools.description: Find wind farms by name (case-insensitive substring), up to 5 matches. farms.json includes some non-Scottish BMUs; report the region field as is.
